contexts.text: They had contemned all Divine worship.
As he had despised others in comparison with himself, he became blacker than others.
With those who are in no charity, there is continuous contempt for others...
Not despising others in comparison with himself...
There are those who in the life of the body have contemned the Word... AC 5719.
At heart they had despised others in comparison with themselves...
They who love themselves either despise, vituperate, or hate all those who are not subservient to them.
Those are in self-love who despise others in comparison with themselves... AC 2219:end. AC 2273. AC 2327:3. AC 7370. AC 8318. AC 9976.
They who come from the Christian world... utterly despise all things which are of charity and faith. AC 3489. AC 3489:2.
In laughter... there is for the most part something of contempt, which, although it does not appear, still lurks there...
Those can never have of the Lord's life who... despise others in comparison with themselves...
All those deny the Lord's Divine Human and Holy proceeding who are in the life of evil, that is, all those who despise others in comparison with themselves...
It is suggested to them... that they are more meritorious than others, whom they despise in comparison with themselves...
Such a religiosity falls into those who are in natural good, but who despise others in comparison with themselves.
Under these loves, hatred against the neighbour hides itself, which is such that... when their loves are attacked, they store up in their disposition contempt against that neighbour...
Temptations take away those things which are... of contempt for others in comparison with ourselves...
They who turn from good by utterly despising truth. Signified. AC 3322:9.
With contempt of soul ().
Esau despised his birthright () = that at present the good of life made nothing of the priority.
Good from proprium has in it... contempt for others.
When they renounce worldly things, they expose themselves to contempt...
Meritoriousness... conjoins itself with... contempt for others. AC 3994:2. AC 9976.
The evils and falsities with which goods and truths cannot be mingled... are hatreds, revenges, cruelties, and thence contempt for others in comparison with ourselves...
He who despises others, attaches to himself like Spirits.
Whatever good he had done to the neighbour he had done for the sake of himself, all others he had despised. (The state and lot of such.)
At this day, as formerly, the Jews despise all others in comparison with themselves.
If his life has been only in external things, as in pleasures from... self-eminence and consequent contempt for others... the spiritual sphere which encompasses him is shocking...
He who in the life of the body has despised others in comparison with himself, in the other life also despises others in comparison with himself.
They hated him = contempt for the Divine truth represented by Joseph. Explained.
These are the interior things of self-love; its exterior things are contempt for others in comparison with ourselves...
Lest we be a contempt () = disgrace.
Such are they who have despised others in comparison with themselves... (See Other.)
They who constitute the province of the gall bladder... are they who in the life of the body have despised what is upright and pious. AC 5187.
He loves himself above all others, whom he thus despises, if not with the mouth, with the heart.
Hence it is, that such utterly despise... the things of Heaven.
As everything of man's life from the proprium is of the love of self and of the world, thus is contempt for others in comparison with ourselves...
(How contempt for others grows.)
Contempt from those who are in the good of charity. Signified.
From these principles he lives... in contempt for others...
Hence come... contempt for others...
Good from man exists with those who... despise the neighbour in comparison with themselves.
They who want to exercise command over others, despise others in comparison with themselves...
They not only despise the neighbour, but also hate him if he does not make one with themselves.
The signs that their sins are not forgiven are... they despise others in comparison with themselves...
In the worst Hells are they who have been in self-love, and consequently in contempt for others...
They may easily fall into contempt for the Word.
When the natural man sees... that the good are in contempt and in poverty...
Such are in Hell... in contempt and misery...
When he sees the worshippers of God in contempt and poverty...
They begin to glory that they are not such sinners as others, which can hardly be separated from... a certain contempt for others in comparison with themselves...
From spiritual cold in marriages there is disunion of souls and disjunction of minds, whence come indifference, discord, contempt...
The evils which are with those who are in the love of dominion from self-love, in general are, contempt for others and where there are such evils, there is also contempt for God and Divine things...
To love the neighbour as one's self, is not to despise him in comparison with self...
All others appear to them as... contemptible.
The same Spirit greatly despised others in comparison with himself... SE 2684. SE 2777. SE 3113. SE 3732. SE 3736. DMin 4549.

On contempt and hatred... Such contempt is of no account when not from self-love, as despising others in comparison with ourselves, and from hatred. These are the contempts which condemn in the other life; but it does not condemn to despise others because they are not clever... for this cannot but be with all men, because they live in society, and one ought to think about the quality of another... Such contempt, although false... does no harm in the other life, being easily dissipated when one is in love and charity... Such have been many of my acquaintances who have despised me, and whom I have despised, not in comparison with myself... nor from hatred... It is the contempt of hatred when anyone wants to take away the honours, goods, or life of another; and to despise others in comparison with one's self, is when anyone regards others as nothing in comparison with himself, [for then] the contempt is of self-love. SE 4384.
(The Hell of those who) have despised others in comparison with themselves.
They who as to the external life have appeared proud, and despisers of the neighbour, and yet have been right and guiltless as to the internal life, come into Heaven. SE 4749, Example(s).
